bid_ask_midpoint_band.interpretation: Bid/ask envelope refit; large values indicate quote uncertainty rather than model extrapolation alone.

double_smoothing_penalty.interpretation: Refit with twice the curvature penalty to test regularisation dependence.

exclude_low_liquidity.interpretation: Refit after removing observations with liquidity score below 0.25.

remove_bonds.interpretation: Refit without coupon-bearing bonds to isolate OIS/deposit support.
